reviews.text: Love the shimmer and color. It has enough shimmer that still shows up under the light. I think I can build up the shadow to get more glitter but the pink is too close to my undertone, next time I need a dark shade :) still love the product overall!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意佢嘅閃粉同顏色。閃粉夠晒，光線下面都睇得到。我覺得可以層層疊上去再閃啲，不過粉紅色太接近我嘅底調，下次我要揀深色啲嘅色號 :) 但整體都好鍾意呢件產品！

reviews.text: I have M18 which is warm-neutral and M19 is a cooler mauve version. It's easy to blend and I think the singles formulation is much better and improved than their palettes. I recommend the single matte shades!
reviews.zh: 我買咗 M18，係暖調中性色，M19 就係冷調偏紫嘅版本。容易推開，我覺得單色嘅配方比佢哋嘅眼影盤好咗、改進咗好多。推薦佢哋嘅單色霧面色號！

reviews.text: doesn't work well for oily lids even with an eyelid primer. very blendable as power is very soft. but at the same time, much more powdery than other formulas (leaves lots of powder after you try to swipe the product using an eyeshadow brush).
reviews.zh: 即使搽咗眼影底霜，對於油眼皮都唔太啱用。粉末好幼，好容易推開。但同一時間，粉感比其它配方重好多（用眼影掃蘸取嘅時候會跌晒粉出嚟）。

reviews.text: I use this for highlighting my nose on natural makeup days. really good and natural, idk what undertone I have but I don't think it really matters with this shade. It does get kinda removed during the day though.
reviews.zh: 我喺化自然妝嘅日子會用佢嚟打鼻樑。真係好自然又好用，我唔知自己咩底調，但覺得用呢個色號都冇乜所謂。不過用咗一日之後會甩得七七八八。

reviews.text: During Korea trip, i can't find multiple colours but I can find specific colour in olive young global website.
reviews.zh: 去韓國旅行嗰陣搵唔到幾個顏色，但喺 Olive Young 全球網站就可以搵到指定顏色。

reviews.text:
Works really well as a matt highlight, I hope they make a larger version of this colour.
Its also easy to use and blend, I use it to cover my dark circle.
Its not particularly warm though, good for warm and cool tone.
reviews.zh:
當霧面 highlight 用效果好好，希望佢哋出多一個大裝嘅呢隻色。
都幾容易用同容易推開，我用佢嚟遮眼圈。
不過就唔算特別暖，暖調冷調都啱用。

reviews.text: The colour is more pink then I thought. It will only work on the aegyosal area on me not my full face as a matt highlight. But the colour is cute. Must suit summer cool people very well.
reviews.zh: 顏色比我想像中更偏粉。喺我面上只適合用喺卧蠶位，唔可以當霧面 highlight 掃成塊面。不過隻色幾得意，夏天冷調肌應該會好啱。

reviews.text: I was worried that this shade would be a little too warm toned for me, but surprisingly it's more on the neutral side, because of how bright it is. I use it for my inner corners and am very satisfied with the formula.
reviews.zh: 本來擔心呢隻色號對我嚟講會偏暖調，但意外地因為夠光，所以比較偏中性。我用佢嚟打眼頭，配方好滿意。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
